# Rococo Froufrou

Rococo Froufrou is a famous *in-universe* Canterlot fashion designer and author whom Rarity admires. His name is spoken in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*, so it is a show-established name, not a fandom invention. Rarity calls him a former “designer to the stars”; Spike mistakenly assumes Rococo is female.

**Appearance and voice:** Rococo is never shown or heard in the verified episode. His coat, mane, species, cutie mark, and voice actor are unknown; Rarity’s correction establishes that he is male. No verified disguise, alternate name, or other portrayal was found. His one substantiated television reference is *What About Discord?* (S5E22, aired November 7, 2015). See the [mentioned-ponies catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Mentioned_ponies).

**Contextual show still (not Rococo):** Rarity and friends in the same episode.

[![Rarity and friends in What About Discord?](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2021/2/18/2284689/full.png)](https://twibooru.org/2284689)

## Important moments

These are **two beats of the same brief reference**, not two on-screen appearances:

- **A place on Rarity’s bookshelf** — *What About Discord?* (S5E22): When Twilight collects Rarity’s donated books, Rarity proudly points out her favorites by Rococo, establishing his reputation. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=egFw5i9TxU4) (scene timestamp unavailable; not independently verified).
- **“Him.”** — *What About Discord?* (S5E22): Spike says he loves “her”; Rarity corrects him, and Spike awkwardly replies “Both.” It is the episode’s clearest confirmation of Rococo’s gender. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/What_About_Discord%3F).
